title: Digital Marketing Agency Dubai: Ads and Email | The Brandle
description: Digital marketing in Dubai from a studio that also builds the landing pages. Google Ads, paid social, email and tracking for a fixed monthly fee.

hub.name: Digital marketing
hub.line: Ads, email and the landing page, planned together.

hero.joke: Paying for clicks that land on a bad page is an expensive way to disappoint strangers.
hero.intro: A digital marketing agency in Dubai that also builds the pages your ads point at. Google Ads, paid social, email and analytics, planned together with the landing page, for a fixed monthly fee.

items.p: Search campaigns built around what people type when they're ready to buy, with the wasteful terms blocked.
Campaigns on Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn, with creative we design so it looks like you.
A page built for each campaign, saying the same thing the ad promised. This is usually where the wasted money is hiding.
Welcome emails, abandoned baskets, follow-ups. Set up once in Klaviyo or Mailchimp, then they run themselves.
Google Analytics 4 and conversion tracking set up and checked with real test conversions, so the numbers mean something.
One page a month: what was spent, what came back, what we're changing. No forty-slide decks.

fit.p: Ads multiply whatever the page already does. A page that turns visitors into enquiries gets more enquiries. A page that doesn't just gets a bigger bill. So we look at the page first.
yes: Running ads that point at your home page
Unable to say which channel brings the leads
Unsure your conversion tracking has ever worked
After one team for the ads and the website
fit.no: your budget is very small. With too little spend there isn't enough data to improve anything, and we'll say so on the first call. Start with [SEO](/services/seo-services/). Only need content? That's [social media marketing](/services/social-media-marketing/).

items.p: We look at the account, the tracking and the pages. You hear what's worth keeping and what to rebuild.
Tracking gets fixed first. Then campaigns and landing pages are built together.
Campaigns go live on a budget you set. We watch closely for the first weeks, when most of the learning happens.
Monthly changes based on what the numbers say, explained in plain words.

price.p: We charge a fixed monthly management fee, quoted after the audit. Not a percentage of your ad spend, because that would reward us for spending more of your money. The ad budget itself is paid by you, straight to the platforms.

faq.a: There's no magic number, but there is a floor. If the budget is too small to produce enough clicks to learn from, managing it wastes your money. We'll tell you honestly on the first call.

faq.q: Do you charge a percentage of spend?
faq.a: No. A fixed monthly fee. Percentage pricing quietly rewards an agency for spending more.

faq.q: Can you take over existing campaigns?
faq.a: Yes. We audit the account first and tell you what can be saved and what should be rebuilt, before touching anything.

faq.q: How quickly will I see results?
faq.a: Search ads can bring enquiries in the first weeks. Bringing the cost of each one down takes a couple of months of data and changes.

cta.p: Tell us what you're spending and what you're getting. We'll tell you what we'd change.
